Grip giving out on pull-ups is a training question I can help with. Let me check what you've logged on pull-ups so I can see where you're at. Nothing logged for pull-ups in the last 12 weeks, so I can't see your sets there. Going by what you describe, the grip is probably the limiter before your back is. A few things help. Start with a dead hang for time, 3 to 5 sets, stopping before your grip fades. Add farmer carries with heavy dumbbells or pinch-grip plate holds to build crushing strength. On pull-up sets, aim for 2 to 3 reps left in the tank rather than grinding to failure, and use a thumbless or false grip only if you're not training to fail. If your grip goes before your back is worked, try lat pulldowns or band-assisted pull-ups to keep volume up while the grip catches up.

If you tell me roughly how many reps you get before it gives out, I can say more about where to start.
